paragraphs: Chapter 739
Episode 184. Beyond Fate (11)
Actions that cannot be understood, words that cannot be understood.
And a figure so weak it's incomprehensible.
His legs felt weak. There was no aura of power from the young Rosa.
She was, in every sense, a human.
[What on earth is going on?]
“Jin, this… human is… a monster."
"We should kill the 12th flagbearer right away…!"
The belated allies also looked back and forth between Jin and Rosa with wide eyes.
Octavia pointed her staff at Rosa, even though she seemed to faint.
Hedo lowered that staff with his hand.
"Captain of the Specters, I don’t know how the situation is progressing, but I think Jin's judgment is correct."
Cough…!
Jin said nothing, focusing on thin air, but when Rosa coughed up a clot of blood, he flinched and looked back at her.
Is she really not a monster?
If this is a monster's plot, what on earth is it trying to gain by going this far?
'It's too much to just confuse me. If all this is really the monster's dog-like prank, after causing confusion, it should have also directly damaged me and the allies.'
However, Rosa, who was freed from the chains, never attacked Jin. The defenselessness shown by the young Rosa was not even threatening enough to the group.
Rosa even protected them while the former family head and the group were fighting just a moment ago.
And the former family head, who was at the peak of fusion with the monster, stabbed Rosa, not Jin, just before he was freed from the chains.
That meant the monster tried to kill itself. Or its own avatar.
'...Avatar?'
Suddenly, one assumption crossed Jin's mind.
What if the dying Rosa is a kind of fragment separated from the monster?
If the assumption is correct, the young Rosa is a being formed by the deepest inner part of the monster that did not want to fall to the end.
It's the result of his own separation, the self from the most shining time that the monster can never return to.
That was the identity of Rosa, who is now dying in front of Jin's eyes.
From the beginning, Rosa didn't even know that she was a fragment from the monster. She perceived the monster and herself as completely different entities.
However, Rosa realized that she was a twisted being. Because this was not the world she remembered.
Why she was trapped in the monster's chain, where Chiron and the other knights of the family are, and what she was doing until just before she was trapped.
Rosa couldn't remember anything.
Even though she looked like a human, she was just an unconsciousness separated from the monster, so it was natural that she couldn't remember anything before being trapped.
Young Rosa's memory stopped on a certain day when she was twenty-three.
On a day that the monster missed the most.
'It seems that I am a twisted being who shouldn't be here. Moreover, the knight named Jin, probably my son, and everyone else are calling me a monster.'
Then, does it mean that the dark beast that was trapping her is her future?
For some reason, she didn't think at all that this could be just a terrible nightmare.
So surely and quickly, she was understanding her situation.
"Haha."
Rosa spat out a metallic laugh.
Various emotions were crossing.
There were so many things she was curious about. How she ended up becoming such a monster, how Chiron is doing, how many children she had, how precarious the family has become because of her.
Rosa felt energy spreading from her pierced chest to her body like poison.
"Jin, a little closer... Can you show me your face?"
Jin didn't answer and looked down at Rosa for a few seconds.

"As you can see, I'm fatally wounded. And that too by a knight controlled by the monster. It's proof that I'm not on his side. Moreover, you and your comrades were at a level where you couldn't dare threaten me even if I was healthy. So let down your guard, I don't have much time left."
Rosa was speaking in a steady voice, concentrating all her remaining energy.
Eventually, Jin kneeled on one side and leaned towards Rosa.
Regaining his distressed mind, he looked again, and the young Rosa's figure was both unfamiliar and familiar.
"You're handsome... It feels like exactly half of Chiron's and my face is mixed. If you're the 12th flagbearer, are you the youngest?"
"…There's one more."
"So, thirteen in total? It seems that the bond between Chiron and I was better than imagined. How is he? Surely, I didn't hurt Chiron?"
"He's in good health."
"Then Chiron must be fulfilling his mission somewhere else. The role of defeating the monster that I have become and reclaiming the family is something you took over from Chiron..."
Jin narrowed his brows every time he heard the word 'you'.
Rosa saw this and smiled faintly.

"Just from your expression, I can see how terrible a mother I was. I must have been the worst ever as the hostess of the family. Although there have been villains in Runcandel who were worse than me, the one who became a monster... was just me."
Young Rosa was a completely different kind from the Rosa that Jin remembered.
The latter was a devil who could do anything for the prosperity and survival of the family.
On the other hand, Rosa, who was bitterly laughing in front of him, had clear and deep eyes that would fit more in Hairan than Runcandel.
"Rosa."
"Speak."
"Why did you do that?"
At Jin's question, Rosa seemed to think for a few seconds.
"I guess I was simply lacking in qualifications and abilities to be the head of the family."

"No, until you became a monster, you were surely the acting head of the family that everyone in the family revered. Nobody thought you were lacking in leading the family in place of your father, and the relatives tried various efforts to gain your recognition."
Rosa shook her head. She was losing strength due to blood loss.

"You were an acting head of the family who even the enemy and those who despised you had to acknowledge. I was the same. Until you conspired with the prophet, until you became a monster. Until you became a mad monster who says it doesn't matter if the whole world is destroyed as long as the flag of Runcandel remains."
"You mean, I said such things......"
"Those are your words and the deeds you're committing."
"This, through the power of chaos?"
Rosa spoke as she placed her hand on her abdomen.
The Chaos that had spread like a tumor was showing itself.
"Yes."
"Then the reason I became a monster is clear."
It's the result of giving up the struggle.
Rosa said in a calm voice.

"Because I was tired, because I could no longer see the path, or because I had done enough and decided it was time to stop. I stopped struggling. Becoming a monster would have been a very easy path. Probably... among the paths I have walked from birth to becoming a monster, it was the most tempting and easy one."
Transparent tears flowed down Rosa's cheeks.
Regret for the future she can't remember, hatred for herself, despair that she can't undo the horrible future no matter what she does, was chilling her inside.
Facing the real Rosa who became a monster, there was nothing he could do.
Jin closed his eyes tightly.
"I am on my way to pay the price as a member of the family. If there is anything to say to the monster, tell me."

"Please...... let death not be a comfortable escape. Let the hideous soul and body be trapped somewhere even in death and fall into torment, never to be released from it, forever. I... by your side... always together, fervently. More fervently than anything else......"
The party held their breath for a moment. Rosa's cursed energy, even in death, poured all her heart into cursing herself, pressing down on the people.
"I will tell her."
Rosa's remaining breath was reaching its end.
Jin decided to watch over her death by her side.
Rosa spoke to Jin as her consciousness faded in and out.
"Jin, do you...... have a lover."
"No."
"In the past."
"I'm not sure."
"You or... the one you hold in your heart."
"Why that in this situation."
"Well, because you're... good-looking... like Chiron. I... liked Chiron... because he was... good-looking."
Ha.
At that point, Jin couldn't help but burst out laughing.
Chiron and Rosa's children never remembered having such an ordinary and useless conversation with their parents.
"Besides... there was no one better looking, no one stronger... I never dated anyone but Chiron."
"Did your father do the same?"
"If he's still wandering the Black Sea, probably... unlike me, Chiron might still be struggling."
Rosa exhaled a hot breath.
"Jin... my son, I'm sorry."
Definitely, stop me.
With those words, Rosa drew her last breath.
All the stories she told up until her death were things that Rosa, as Jin remembered her, could never say.
'Yeah, I will do that.'
Jin answered silently, closing Rosa's eyelids quietly.
Just as the dead Rosa regretted a future she did not know, Jin was saying goodbye to a mother from a past he did not know.
There was silence for a while.
"...The dead Rosa was probably an ego or a soul separated from the monster."
At Jin's words, the group nodded. They too had been speculating the same as Jin while listening to the conversation between the two.

[Maybe the monster itself did not want it or it was an unexpected separation. I don't remember feeling anything about the child in the monster's mind during the time I was bound. Besides, the monster attacked through this head of the family at the last moment, it wasn't you, but the child.]
Alphen lifted the former head of the family, who had been lying next to Rosa, and spoke.
He was still unconscious, and both Jin and Alphen didn't know his identity.
The body of the young Rosa was turning black. The tumor of chaos that started from her chest was visibly growing rapidly.
Jin raised a flame in his palm.
It seemed necessary to take care of the body before it got worse and then leave.
However, Jin, who was about to drop the flame, raised his head in surprise.
Suddenly, the monster's voice was heard.
[I wonder what you think of watching the last of my humanity disappear, youngest. This mother was hoping you would end it yourself... but this isn't bad either.]
